matches.rationale: GT1 concerns conflicting definitions of network depth (residual blocks vs. Dense layers) across the Preliminaries section. Pred_1 identifies a parameter-scaling error in Section 4.4 (linear vs. quadratic claims reversed). These are different defects in different locations with different mechanisms.

GT2 concerns an inconsistency between L2-norm and dot-product definitions of the critic output function. Pred_2 identifies a mathematical error in the Q-function identity equation $Q_g^\pi(s,a) = p_\gamma^\pi(g \mid s,a)$. These are distinct defects: one is about the choice of similarity metric, the other about an incorrect mathematical equality.
